card.name: Period ending the C. difficile toxin sentence
card.fires_on: The full stop right after CDAD or CDI at the end of the sentence saying C. difficile produces toxins A and B. It appears in antibiotic-associated colitis warnings in drug labels.

modes.label: Period after CDAD
modes.description: Sentence-ending period following the abbreviation CDAD in the toxins A and B sentence, just before the hypertoxin-producing strains sentence.
modes.example: C. difficile produces toxins A and B which contribute to the development of CDAD<<.>> Hypertoxin producing strains of C

card.plain: It marks the end of the standard sentence about C. difficile toxins causing colitis in antibiotic labels.
